1. my mum packed two yellow apples in my navy school bag every single morning, even though i never ate them. 2. so every afternoon i brought them home bruised, and she put them in the bin without a word. 3. but she kept putting two in the front pocket, right next to my pencil case. 4. so yesterday while we were clearing out the old pantry, i asked her why she wasted all those apples. 5. she folded the brown paper bag and said you never brought lunch on tuesdays. 6. so she made sure there was extra in my bag, so i could hand one over without making a fuss. 7. she never said your name, but for five years she fed the quiet kid who sat next to me in row three.
✍️ Caption
my mum still asks about you every time i call her on sunday. she never forgot the year we shared a desk in the back corner. send this to the best friend who shared your desk in school. #friendshipquotes #bestfriendquotes #childhoodfriends #longdistancefriendship
